'''Antiox breath masks''' were used by [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] to survive in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] and [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheres]]. The [[Breath mask/Legends|breath mask]] provided the mixture of unique gases found on Dorin's atmosphere ([[Dorin gas/Legends|Dorin gas]] and [[Helium/Legends|helium]]), while reducing the oxygen level to one which was tolerable by [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] physiology. It also protected the wearer's [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] from the harmful effects of oxygen to Kel Dor.

Most breath masks shared a similar shape, but appeared to exhibit variations from individual to individual. The most commonly seen color was black. [[Sha Koon]] wore a different mask during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] than the one she wore during the [[Stark Hyperspace War/Legends|Stark Hyperspace War]]. Over a century after the fall of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], metal breath masks were worn by [[Sha Dun]] and [[Pol Temm]].

As Dorin joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in [[5975 BBY]] and received direct representation within the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], it is likely these masks had been invented by that time. Around the [[Great Galactic War]], two Kel Dor [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], [[Zym]] and [[Gnost-Dural]] wore antiox breath masks. Noticeably, Zym's mask was more rounded and ovular in shape, whereas Gnost-Dural's resembled more modern designs seen during the Republic's final days.

{{Tech-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Antiox breath mask is misspelled as "antitox breath mask" in the [[2015]] [[roleplaying game]] guide [[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]] on page 58.
